explication: Langfuse is an LLM engineering platform for developing, monitoring, evaluating, and debugging AI applications. Its central workflow is to send application traces to Langfuse, inspect traces and sessions, and use evaluation and development tools to improve the application. The repository also contains prompt management, datasets, a playground, and APIs. The graph includes sampled storage and export-worker internals; several product capabilities are represented by their source directories because their implementation was not sampled.
